content:
**One Star - Worst Purchase Ever**

I bought this foam mattress expecting a good night's sleep, but instead I wake up every morning drenched in sweat because it retains heat like an oven. The "medium firm" description is a complete lie – it feels like sleeping on a rock with zero give or comfort. Within just three weeks, there's already a noticeable body impression that makes me roll toward the center of the bed. The chemical smell was so overwhelming when I unboxed it that I had to let it air out for two weeks, and it still hasn't fully gone away. My back pain has actually gotten significantly worse since switching to this mattress, which is the opposite of what I was hoping for. The edge support is nonexistent, so sitting on the side of the bed feels like you're about to slide right off onto the floor. Customer service was absolutely useless when I tried to initiate a return, giving me the runaround for weeks. Save your money and look elsewhere because this mattress belongs in a dumpster, not a bedroom.
